final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT t.observstation, o.weathprofile, COUNT(*) AS group_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation COLLATE BINARY = o.observstation COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY t.observstation COLLATE BINARY, o.weathprofile COLLATE BINARY), step2 AS (SELECT weathprofile, AVG(group_count) AS avg_count FROM step1 GROUP BY weathprofile COLLATE BINARY) SELECT s1.observstation, s1.weathprofile, s1.group_count, s1.group_count - s2.avg_count AS difference FROM step1 AS s1 JOIN step2 AS s2 ON s1.weathprofile COLLATE BINARY = s2.weathprofile COLLATE BINARY WHERE s1.group_count > s2.avg_count ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
